original_target.title: The Singer conjecture for all closed aspherical manifolds

scope_comparison: Published DiCerbo–Lombardi Theorem1.3 requires smooth projective variety, semismall Albanese map and residually finite fundamental group. Theorem1.4 concerns algebraic universal cover, not arbitrary topological aspherical manifolds. Current OpenAI315 index is dimension4 only, not all dimensions.
